title: Contract inherits from `Pausable` but does not expose pausing/unpausing functionality
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low, as methods do not have `whenNotPaused` modifier  **Likelihood:** High, as it is certain that contract can't be paused at all  ## Description  The `Organizer` smart contract inherits from OpenZeppelin's `Pausable` contract, but the `_pause` and `_unpause` methods are not exposed externally to be callable and also no method actually uses the `whenNotPaused` modifier.
